## key relational paths (ascending reliability)
  [0.400] within bounds -> reflect direction --parameterizes-- vertical_towards
  [0.500] which side of rectangle hit --same_as-- within bounds --related_to-- vertical line beneath object criteria
  [0.500] which side of rectangle hit --same_as-- within bounds --related_to-- vertical line beneath object criteria
  [0.500] within bounds --same_as-- pixel is inside grid criteria --same_as-- vertical_towards
  [0.667] within bounds --related_to-- vertical line beneath object criteria

## adapted PathRAG relational paths (ascending reliability)
  [0.950] vertical_towards: determine the vertical direction from source to target; vertical_towards parameterizes target; the target object or pixel; target has y-coordinate; vertical position of a pixel; if target.y < source.y then up; direction when target.y < source.y
  [0.950] vertical_towards: determine the vertical direction from source to target; vertical_towards parameterizes source; the source object or pixel; source has y-coordinate; vertical position of a pixel; if target.y > source.y then down; direction when target.y > source.y
  [0.950] which side of rectangle hit: determine which side of a rectangle a given position is on; takes position as input; the given position to check; takes rectangle as input; the rectangle to check against; uses bounding box of rectangle; rectangle's bounding box
  [0.950] vertical line beneath object criteria: condition on whether a pixel is directly beneath an object; checks if pixel is directly beneath object; the pixel being checked; pixel undergoes upward movement; move upward from pixel to check first non-background pixel; upward movement targets first non-background pixel; the first non-background pixel encountered moving upward
  [0.950] pixel is inside grid criteria: check if a pixel position is within the bounds of the grid; checks parameter; the pixel position to check

## types
- axis := Literal["x", "y", "both", "horizontal", "vertical"] | int | float | tuple[axis, int | float]
- dimensions := tuple[int, int]
- direction := Literal["up", "down", "left", "right"]
- list[symmetry := Callable[[position], position]]
- pattern := str | Callable[[int], grid]
- shape := Any
- symmetry := Callable[[position], position]

## other routines
### intermediate
- concept: within bounds
  description: check if a given position is within the valid bounds of the grid
  output_typing: bool
  parameters:
    - position (type: position)
    - grid (type: grid)
  implementation:
    - check that 0 <= x < grid width and 0 <= y < grid height
- concept: reflect direction
  description: compute the new direction after reflecting off a rectangle side, given the incoming direction and the side hit
  output_typing: direction
  parameters:
    - direction (type: direction)
    - hit_side (type: Literal["left", "right", "top", "bottom"])
  implementation:
    - for each side, reverse the appropriate component of the direction (e.g., hitting "left" or "right" reverses x, "top" or "bottom" reverses y)
- concept: which side of rectangle hit
  description: determine which side of a rectangle a given position is on (left, right, top, or bottom)
  output_typing: Literal["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]
  parameters:
    - position (type: position)
    - rectangle (type: object)
  implementation:
    - compare the position to the rectangle's bounding box; if x equals min_x, it's the left side, etc.
- concept: vertical_towards
  description: determine the vertical direction ("up" or "down") from the source to the target
  output_typing: direction := Literal["up", "down"]
  parameters:
    - target (type: object | position)
    - source (type: object | position)
  implementation:
    - compare the y-coordinates of source and target; if target.y > source.y, direction is "down", else "up"
### selection criteria
- concept: pixel is inside grid criteria
  description: check if a pixel position is within the bounds of the grid
  output_typing: bool
  parameters:
    - position (type: position)
    - grid (type: grid)
  implementation:
    - check that 0 <= x < grid width and 0 <= y < grid height
- concept: vertical line beneath object criteria
  description: condition on whether a pixel is directly beneath an object (e.g., chevron), i.e., moving upward from the pixel encounters the object before any other occurrence of the object color.
  output_typing: bool
  parameters:
    - pixel (type: object)
    - object (type: object)
    - grid (type: grid)
  implementation:
    - for the given pixel, move upward (decreasing y) and check if the first non-background pixel encountered is part of the object
    - ensure there are no object pixels between the pixel and the object above
